metadata.scenario: An individual planning a group retreat calls to get a quote for holistic therapy sessions. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I’m calling to inquire about holistic therapy sessions for a group retreat we’re planning. Hello, Agnes! It's great to hear from you. What specific services are you looking for? We're considering a mix of physical therapy and possibly some relaxation techniques. That sounds wonderful! We have some excellent options for physical therapy; our sessions last about 45-60 minutes. Wonderful! And do you have any information on the pricing? Yes, our physical therapy sessions are priced between $110 and $140 per session. Great, that’s within our budget. What about the relaxation techniques? For relaxation, we can offer companion care that includes activities like meditation and guided relaxation for $25 to $30 per hour. That sounds perfect. How many hours would you recommend for a retreat? Typically, I’d suggest at least two hours for each session to really benefit from the relaxation techniques alongside the physical therapy. So if we have five people, how much would that cost? Let’s see... if we do two hours of physical therapy for five people, that would be around $1,100 at the highest rate. And for the relaxation sessions? For five people at two hours, that would range from $250 to $300 for companion care. Okay, so together that's around $1,400 to $1,500 total? Yes, that’s correct, Agnes! Would you like to proceed with scheduling? I’d like to think it over first. Could you send me a detailed quote via email? Absolutely! I can send a detailed quote. Could you please confirm your email address for me? Sure, it’s agnes.rodriguez@email.com. Thank you, Agnes. I’ll send that over right away. Great! One more thing, would you have a PT available for the sessions? Yes, Dr. James Rodriguez, our physical therapist, is available. I can include his schedule in the email. That would be perfect. Thanks for all your help, Margaret! You’re welcome, Agnes! I’ll follow up with that email shortly. I appreciate it! Have a great day! You too, take care!
